I said no the other woman didn’t ask for it but she had watched me sit down on the seats.\nThe receptionist then literally shouted at me telling me that I have to give my name when I come in.  I said, “Why are you shouting at me I don’t know what your policies are, the other woman should have asked my name!” Her face changed once I pulled her up for shouting and she said I’ll see if the Doctor will see you.  A few minutes later she came back and said the Doctor would see me. Then a few minutes after that she came back and said the Doctor won’t see you.\nI stood up and I was still very annoyed about her shouting at me and I said, “ I suppose that’s my fault is it?” I was fuming at the way she had reprimanded me from behind the counter and now I had wasted my time on top of that.\nIt was unnecessary for her to raise her voice to me and tell me off in such a manner. I phoned the practice from my car,  I said, “I am the woman you just threw out can you get the practice manager to call me tomorrow please?” She said she didn’t throw me out.  I said, “I was due an appointment at 10 to 5 and I’ve been told I can’t have one because you are closing!” She said the manager won’t call you you’ll have to e-mail.  I said I’ll take the e-mail address. I told her that the manager called me last time and it’s the second time I’ve had to complain about this surgery.\nI am fed up of the poor service at West End Medical Centre. I have read the reviews online and this place scores a two. The sorry thing is, you have to give at least a one star rating to do a review. This place needs its customer service looking at and perhaps regular secret checks. I contacted the eye hospital on the 15th and they said my referral had been returned to the GP on December 21st 2023 with a reason why my appointment had been returned.  During this time I had spoken to my GP on the phone and had another eye infection and seen him face to face and at no point during this two month period did anybody tell me my appointment had been refused!  I have now been told the next option is for me to be referred to another service, no idea how long I am supposed to wait or if I can trust any information getting back to me.
